title: Boston Shriners Hospital says it’s seeing multiple burn patients every week from this popular type of toy
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Local News Shriners Children’s Boston is seeing an "alarming" number of patients with severe burns due to gel-filled fidget toys exploding Doctors at Shriners Children’s Boston are warning families against a social media trend encouraging people to microwave gel-filled fidget toys, resulting in severe scald and chemical burns.

Shriners Children’s is seeing an “alarming” number of patients with severe burns due to the gel inside the toys exploding, often affecting people’s face, neck and hands, the hospital said in a press release.

“What many families don’t realize is that even 15 seconds, possibly less, in the microwave can heat the gel inside these toys to dangerous temperatures,” Shriners Children’s associate surgeon Colleen Ryan said in the release.
